name: user-menu
title: User menu
description: Avatar button for the topbar that opens a menu with name, email, your links and Sign out.
htmlExample:
<bef-user-menu name="Aarav Mehta" email="aarav@acme.co" :items='[{"label":"Profile","icon":"<bef-user-circle-icon></bef-user-circle-icon>"},{"label":"Billing","icon":"<bef-wallet-icon></bef-wallet-icon>"},{"label":"Settings","icon":"<bef-settings-icon></bef-settings-icon>"}]' id="g1"></bef-user-menu>
<script type="module">
document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  onSignOut: () => befui.toast.success("Signed out"),
};
</script>
